products.name: Monitaur
products.note: Model monitoring with built-in governance; unified monitoring + governance platform

profile_text.body:
Monitaur is a software company focused on AI governance, describing itself as providing "actionable governance for the entire lifecycle of your AI." Its platform is designed to help enterprises establish company-wide standards and controls for AI systems, covering policy unification, model validation, continuous performance monitoring, and regulatory compliance reporting. The company emphasizes use cases in insurance and financial services, including underwriting, claims, and risk models, and highlights the ability to govern both internally built and third-party vendor AI projects.

The core product, also called Monitaur, is categorized as an AI Governance and Risk Management Platform that combines model monitoring with built-in governance tooling. The site references case studies involving a leading insurance provider, an enterprise insurer managing third-party AI projects, and a Fortune 200 financial services company, though none are named. Monitaur also notes a placement in Gartner's inaugural Magic Quadrant for AI Governance as a Visionary, and the company produces content addressing topics such as agentic AI governance, the NAIC AI evaluation tool pilot, and AI token economics.

The held facts confirm Monitaur has an active profile on theworldofai.org, with its platform listed under the AI Governance and Risk Management Platforms category. No litigation, MCP server registrations, SEC filings, or patent records are present in the available data.
